58746-memoir-of-the-life-and-services-of.title: Memoir Of The Life And Services Of Vice Admiral Sir Jahleel
58746-memoir-of-the-life-and-services-of.creator: Unknown
58746-memoir-of-the-life-and-services-of.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. best; I have endeavoured to shew what he was, by describing his behaviour under the several trials of his eventful life; and to extend the benefit of his example by making it more generally known.

arxiv-1908-09179.title: Commutators, matrices and an identity of Copeland
arxiv-1908-09179.creator: Darij Grinberg
arxiv-1908-09179.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Darij Grinberg. Given two elements a a and b b of a noncommutative ring, we express ( b ​ a ) n \left(ba\right)^{n} as a “row vector times matrix times column vector” product, where the matrix is the n n -th power of a matrix with entries ( i j ) ​ ad a i − j ​ ( b ) \dbinom{i}{j}\operatorname*{ad}\nolimits_{a}^{i-j}\left(b\right) . This generalizes a formula by Tom Copeland used in the study of Pascal-style matrices.

arxiv-1910-10916.title: Soft Prototyping Camera Designs for Car Detection Based on a Convolutional Neural Network
arxiv-1910-10916.creator: Zhenyi Liu, Trisha Lian, Joyce Farrell, Brian Wandell
arxiv-1910-10916.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Zhenyi Liu, Trisha Lian, Joyce Farrell, Brian Wandell. Imaging systems are increasingly used as input to convolutional neural networks (CNN) for object detection; we would like to design cameras that are optimized for this purpose. It is impractical to build different cameras and then acquire and label the necessary data for every potential camera design; creating software simulations of the camera in context (soft prototyping) is the only realistic approach.

arxiv-2011-03117.title: IFC models for (semi)automating common planning checks for building permits Journal: Automation in Construction
arxiv-2011-03117.creator: Francesca Noardo, Teng Wu, Ken Arroyo Ohori, Thomas Krijnen, Jantien Stoter
arxiv-2011-03117.description: Abstract To support building permit issuing with automatic digital tools, the reuse of models produced by designers would make the process quicker and more objective. However, current studies and pilots often leave a gap with respect to the models as actually provided by architects, having varying quality and content.

arxiv-2101-02127.title: RethNet: Object-by-Object Learning for Detecting Facial Skin Problems
arxiv-2101-02127.creator: Shohrukh Bekmirzaev, Seoyoung Oh, Sangwook Yoo
arxiv-2101-02127.description: Abstract Semantic segmentation is a hot topic in computer vision where the most challenging tasks of object detection and recognition have been handling by the success of semantic segmentation approaches. We propose a concept of object-by-object learning technique to detect 11 types of facial skin lesions using semantic segmentation methods.

arxiv-2108-01578.title: SPG-VTON: Semantic Prediction Guidance for Multi-pose Virtual Try-on
arxiv-2108-01578.creator: Bingwen Hu, Ping Liu, Zhedong Zheng, Mingwu Ren
arxiv-2108-01578.description: Abstract Image-based virtual try-on is challenging in fitting target in-shop clothes onto a reference person under diverse human poses. Previous works focus on preserving clothing details ( e.g., texture, logos, patterns) when transferring desired clothes onto a target person under a fixed pose. However, the performances of existing methods significantly dropped when extending existing methods to multi-pose virtual try-on.

arxiv-2204-03478.title: Star-dust geometry main determinant of dust attenuation in galaxies 2020 Star-dust geometry main determinant of dust attenuation in galaxies –
arxiv-2204-03478.creator: Sonali Sachdeva, Biman B. Nath
arxiv-2204-03478.description: Abstract Analysing a large representative sample of local galaxies (8707), we find that the variation in the shape of their dust attenuation curves is driven primarily by their structure, i.e., distribution of stars (and dust) within them. The attenuation curve for spheroid dominated galaxies, as compared to the disc dominated ones, is nearly twice as steep.

arxiv-2404-01874.title: Laser mode-hopping assisted all-optical single beam pulsed atomic magnetometer
arxiv-2404-01874.creator: Ji Hoon Yoon, Sang Hyuk Hong, Taek Jeong, Sin Hyuk Yim, Kyu Min Shim, and Sangkyung Lee
arxiv-2404-01874.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ji Hoon Yoon, Sang Hyuk Hong, Taek Jeong, Sin Hyuk Yim, Kyu Min Shim, and Sangkyung Lee. We demonstrate an all-optical single beam pulsed atomic magnetometer assisted by laser mode-hopping in a distributed Bragg reflector (DBR) laser. We implement a temporal sequence of the laser current, with sinusoidal current modulation including the laser mode-hop current for synchronous optical pumping, and a following constant current for paramagnetic Faraday rotation measurements, to probe the free induction decay (FID) of transverse 87 Rb spin polarization.

arxiv-2406-07092.title: Truncated pushforwards and refined unramified cohomology
arxiv-2406-07092.creator: Theodosis Alexandrou, Stefan Schreieder
arxiv-2406-07092.description: Abstract . For a large class of cohomology theories, we prove that refined unramified cohomology is canonically isomorphic to the hypercohomology of a natural truncated complex of Zariski sheaves. This generalizes a classical result of Bloch and Ogus and solves a conjecture of Kok and Zhou. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification primary 14C15, 14C25, secondary 14F20 1.

arxiv-2407-09231.title: Prompts First, Finally CCS: Computing methodologies Artificial intelligence CCS: Social and professional topics Computer science education CCS: Social and professional topics Computing education
arxiv-2407-09231.creator: Brent N. Reeves, James Prather, Paul Denny, Juho Leinonen, Stephen MacNeil, Brett A. Becker, Andrew Luxton-Reilly
arxiv-2407-09231.description: Abstract . Generative AI (GenAI) and large language models in particular, are disrupting Computer Science Education. They are proving increasingly capable at more and more challenges. Some educators argue that they pose a serious threat to computing education, and that we should ban their use in the classroom.

arxiv-2409-09787.title: BNEM: A Boltzmann Sampler Based on Bootstrapped Noised Energy Matching
arxiv-2409-09787.creator: RuiKang OuYang * ro352@cam.ac.uk, Bo Qiang * bqiang@uw.edu, José Miguel Hernández-Lobato jmh233@cam.ac.uk
arxiv-2409-09787.description: Abstract Generating independent samples from a Boltzmann distribution is a highly relevant problem in scientific research, e.g. in molecular dynamics, where one has initial access to the underlying energy function but not to samples from the Boltzmann distribution. We address this problem by learning the energies of the convolution of the Boltzmann distribution with Gaussian noise.

arxiv-2412-15764.title: The variety of complemented lattices where the Sasaki operations form an adjoint pair
arxiv-2412-15764.creator: Václav Cenker, Ivan Chajda, Helmut Länger
arxiv-2412-15764.description: Abstract The Sasaki projection was introduced as a mapping from the lattice of closed subspaces of a Hilbert space onto one of its segments. To use this projection and its dual so-called Sasaki operations were introduced by the second two authors in [ 4 ] and [ 6 ] .

arxiv-2501-18986.title: A Systematic Literature Review of Computer Science MOOCs for K-12 education
arxiv-2501-18986.creator: L.M. van der Lubbe, S.P. van Borkulo, J.T. Jeuring
arxiv-2501-18986.description: Abstract Computer science (CS) is increasingly becoming part of the curricula of K-12 education in different countries. However, there are few K-12 CS teachers, and tools to offer K-12 CS education are often limited. Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs) might help to temporarily address these challenges, and enable more schools to offer CS education.

arxiv-2504-20214.title: Acceleration of Convergence of Double Series for the Green’s Function of the Helmholtz Equation in Polar Coordinates
arxiv-2504-20214.creator: Igor M. Braver
arxiv-2504-20214.description: Abstract The well-known expressions for the Green’s functions for the Helmholtz equation in polar coordinates with Dirichlet and Neumann boundary conditions are transformed. The slowly converging double series describing these Green’s functions are reduced by means of successive subtraction of several auxiliary functions to series that converge much more rapidly.

arxiv-2505-00020.title: Beyond Public Access in LLM Pre-Training Data Non-public book content in OpenAI’s Models
arxiv-2505-00020.creator: Sruly Rosenblat, Tim O’Reilly, Ilan Strauss
arxiv-2505-00020.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sruly Rosenblat, Tim O’Reilly, Ilan Strauss. Using a legally obtained dataset of 34 copyrighted O’Reilly Media books, we apply the DE-COP membership inference attack method to investigate whether OpenAI’s large language models were trained on copyrighted content without consent. Our AUROC scores show that GPT-4o, OpenAI’s more recent and capable model, demonstrates strong recognition of paywalled O’Reilly book content (AUROC = 82%), compared to OpenAI’s earlier model GPT-3.5 Turbo. In contrast, GPT-3.5 Turbo shows greater relative recognition of publicly accessible O’Reilly book samples.

arxiv-2505-08565.title: On testing the class of symmetry using entropy characterization and empirical likelihood approach
arxiv-2505-08565.creator: Ganesh Vishnu Avhad, Ananya Lahiri, Sudheesh K. Kattumannil
arxiv-2505-08565.description: Abstract In this paper, we obtain a new characterization result for symmetric distributions based on the entropy measure. Using the characterization, we propose a nonparametric test to test the symmetry of a distribution. We also develop the jackknife empirical likelihood and the adjusted jackknife empirical likelihood ratio tests. The asymptotic properties of the proposed test statistics are studied.

arxiv-2509-06714.title: RT-HCP: Dealing with Inference Delays and Sample Efficiency to Learn Directly on Robotic Platforms
arxiv-2509-06714.creator: Zakariae El Asri, Ibrahim Laiche, Clément Rambour, Olivier Sigaud, Nicolas Thome
arxiv-2509-06714.description: Abstract Learning a controller directly on the robot requires extreme sample efficiency. Model-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods are the most sample efficient, but they often suffer from a too long inference time to meet the robot control frequency requirements. In this paper, we address the sample efficiency and inference time challenges with two contributions.

arxiv-2511-15638.title: Learning from Imperfect Labels: A Physics-Aware Neural Operator with Application to DAS Data Denoising
arxiv-2511-15638.creator: Yang Cui, Denis Anikiev, Umair Bin Waheed, Yangkang Chen
arxiv-2511-15638.description: Abstract Supervised deep learning methods typically require large datasets and high-quality labels to achieve reliable predictions. However, their performance often degrades when trained on imperfect labels. To address this challenge, we propose a physics-aware loss function that serves as a penalty term to mitigate label imperfections during training.

arxiv-2512-15611.title: Implementation of the Quantum Fourier Transform on a molecular qudit with full refocusing and state tomography
arxiv-2512-15611.creator: Marcos Rubín-Osanz 1 , Laura Bersani 1 , Simone Chicco 1 , Giuseppe Allodi 1 , Roberto De Renzi 1 , Athanasios Mavromagoulos 2 , Michael D. Roy 2 , Stergios Piligkos 2,∗ , Elena Garlatti 1,3,∗ , Stefano Carretta 1,3
arxiv-2512-15611.description: Abstract Molecular spin qudits based on lanthanide complexes offer a promising platform for quantum technologies, combining chemical tunability with multi-level encoding. However, experimental demonstrations of their envisaged capabilities remain scarce, posing the difficulty of achieving precise control over coherences between qudit states in long pulse sequences.

arxiv-2602-18551.title: From Static Spectra to Operando Infrared Dynamics: Physics Informed Flow Modeling and a Benchmark
arxiv-2602-18551.creator: Shuquan Ye, Ben Fei, Hongbin Xu, Jiaying Lin, Wanli Ouyang
arxiv-2602-18551.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Shuquan Ye, Ben Fei, Hongbin Xu, Jiaying Lin, Wanli Ouyang. The Solid Electrolyte Interphase (SEI) is critical to the performance of lithium-ion batteries, yet its analysis via Operando Infrared (IR) spectroscopy remains experimentally complex and expensive, which limits its accessibility for standard research facilities. To overcome this bottleneck, we formulate a novel task, Operando IR Prediction, which aims to forecast the time-resolved evolution of spectral “fingerprints” from a single static spectrum.

plos-pone-0008352.title: The Intestinal Spirochete Brachyspira pilosicoli Attaches to Cultured Caco-2 Cells and Induces Pathological Changes
plos-pone-0008352.creator: Ram Naresh, Yong Song, David J. Hampson
plos-pone-0008352.description: PLOS ONE research article. Brachyspira pilosicoli is an anaerobic spirochete that has received relatively little study, partly due to its specialized culture requirements and slow growth. This bacterium colonizes the large intestine of various species, including humans; typically, a dense layer of spiroche

pmc-10544975.title: Preferred physical characteristics of lidocaine thin film for women with vestibulodynia
pmc-10544975.creator: R. Gina Silverstein, Martha Grace Cromeens, Caroline Rowland, Joseph A. Ogbansiegbe, Paul Mihas, S. Rahima Benhabbour, Erin T. Carey
pmc-10544975.description: IntroductionVestibulodynia (VBD) is the most common cause of sexual pain in the United States, affecting up to 15% of reproductive-aged women during their lifetime with limited treatment options. The purpose of this study was to describe ideal physical characteristics of a vulvar film designed for insertional sexual pain in sexually active women with VBD.

pmc-10637006.title: Case report: hunting the hidden: surgical treatment of chronic silent thrombus in the left ventricle in a young alcoholic patient with myocardial bridging
pmc-10637006.creator: Fengpu He, Yiping Jiao, Lijun Jiang
pmc-10637006.description: BackgroundA silent left ventricular thrombus is dangerous. The current standard anticoagulation therapy was ineffective in our case or similar, and the outcome was poor.Case presentationA 33-year-old man with a silent left ventricular thrombus was detected incidentally by transthoracic echocardiography. After admission, anti-coagulation with low-molecular-weight heparin therapy was carried out.

pmc-11507225.title: Emulsion Structural Remodeling in Milk and Its Gelling Products: A Review
pmc-11507225.creator: Dexing Yao, Le-Chang Sun, Ling-Jing Zhang, Yu-Lei Chen, Song Miao, Ming-Jie Cao, Duanquan Lin, Esmaiel Jabbari
pmc-11507225.description: The fat covered by fat globule membrane is scattered in a water phase rich in lactose and milky protein, forming the original emulsion structure of milk. In order to develop low-fat milk products with good performance or dairy products with nutritional reinforcement, the original emulsion structure of milk can be restructured.

pmc-11510247.title: 6-Shogaol Abrogates Parkinson’s Disease in Rotenone-Induced Rodents: Based on In Silico Study and Inhibiting TNF-α/NF-κB/IL-1β/MAO-B
pmc-11510247.creator: Misbahuddin Rafeeq, Fahad A. Al-Abbasi, Muhammad Afzal, Ehssan Moglad, Salwa D. Al-Qahtani, Sami I. Alzrea, Naif A. R. Almalki, Faisal Imam, Nadeem Sayyed, Imran Kazmi
pmc-11510247.description: Background/Objectives: 6-Shogaol is a comparatively innovative anti-Parkinson’s remedy with antioxidant and anti-inflammatory characteristics. This investigation intended to determine the role of 6-shogaol in the Parkinson’s disease (PD) paradigm in rotenone-induced rats. Methods: Thirty male Wistar rats (10–12 weeks old; 180 ± 20 g) were divided into five groups.

pmc-11539592.title: The clinical anti-inflammatory effects and underlying mechanisms of silymarin
pmc-11539592.creator: Yuqi Zhao, Yingyu Zhou, Ting Gong, Zhiting Liu, Wanying Yang, Yi Xiong, Dan Xiao, Alejandro Cifuentes, Elena Ibáñez, Weihong Lu
pmc-11539592.description: SummaryInflammatory conditions are key mediators in the progression of various diseases. Silymarin, derived from Silybum marianum seeds and fruits, has shown efficacy in treating a range of liver diseases. The expanding corpus of research on silymarin highlights its promising role in preventing and managing inflammatory conditions and autoimmune without adverse effects.

pmc-12446028.title: Progress in epigenetic research of breast cancer: a bibliometric analysis since the 2000s
pmc-12446028.creator: Hua Yang, Yu Fang, Haijuan Wang, Ting Lu, Qihua Chen, Hui Liu
pmc-12446028.description: BackgroundBreast cancer continues to be a leading cause of cancer-related deaths among women worldwide. Despite advancements in diagnostics and therapies, challenges such as metastasis, recurrence, and resistance remain prevalent. Recently, research has shifted from traditional genomic analyses to the study of epigenetic regulation, which includes DNA methylation, histone modifications, and non-coding RNAs.

pmc-13194238.title: Social communicative characteristics of adolescent police dogs: Acquired experience plays a crucial role
pmc-13194238.creator: Xinyu Huang, Xisheng Mei, Kui Wan, Chao Chen, Lu Wang, Xiaoyang Wang, Guo-Dong Wang
pmc-13194238.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The domestic dog is known for its strong ability to respond to human social cues. However, conclusions based on highly socialized dogs may not generalize to all populations since acquired experience is known to greatly influence canine cognition. To further explore this question, we employed a classic gesture comprehension paradigm to test a group of adolescent police dogs with distinct background.

pmc-13217924.title: Eukaryotic cell-free protein synthesis: Chassis diversification, system engineering, and emerging applications
pmc-13217924.creator: Shengxin Tong, Yiming Wang, Xin Wang, Xiaowen Jin, Duoduo Tan, Ze Wang, Yuan Lu
pmc-13217924.description: The eukaryotic cell-free protein synthesis (CFPS) system, endowed with intrinsic post-translational modification capabilities and a complex molecular chaperone network, efficiently synthesizes functional proteins with correct conformation and biological activity. This effectively compensates for the structural limitations of prokaryotic systems in expressing complex eukaryotic proteins.

pmc-13275740.title: Is “sky” bluer than “grass” is green? Word–color associations dataset for cognitive science
pmc-13275740.creator: Eldad Keha, Avishai Henik, Eyal Kalanthroff

pmc-13453988.title: A feasibility study of an artificial intelligence based decision support system for personalised housing adaptations and assistive technology
pmc-13453988.creator: Divya Saleela, Adekunle S Oyegoke, Jamiu A Dauda, Saheed O Ajayi
pmc-13453988.description: This feasibility study explores the development of the HomeAI-Enable system, an AI-driven decision support platform designed to provide personalised housing adaptations and assistive technology recommendations for older adults and individuals with disabilities. The study follows a constructive research approach including focus groups and brainstorming exercises in addition to development research techniques.

pmc-13545878.title: Comparative efficacy and cytocompatibility of antimicrobial nanocoatings versus antibiotics on titanium dental implant surfaces
pmc-13545878.creator: Maitreyi Ranjan, Shailesh Jain, Nikhil Prakash, Monika Sinha, Shabnam Chaudhary, Roli Singh
pmc-13545878.description: Bacterial colonization resulting in peri-implantitis is a significant issue in dental implantology which results in an implant failure. Therefore, it is of interest to evaluate the antimicrobial efficacy and cytocompatibility of nanoparticle-based-coatings and conventional antibiotic-coatings on the titanium dental implant surfaces were compared.
